children.name:
Tie each exact ticket and specification revision to its implementation,
      verification, and deployment evidence without pretending that a merge or
      successful build is already a production outcome.
terms:
"
      Tie each exact ticket and specification revision to its implementation,
      verification, and deployment evidence without pretending that a merge or
      successful build is already a production outcome.
      "
"Bind verification and deployment to an immutable change set containing exact definition, specification, diff, commit, and run references."
"Approvals and test results become unsafe when later code or requirements can silently inherit them."
"Do not deploy a branch name, latest ticket, mutable tag, or agent assertion as if it identified verified content."

children.name: A change set belongs to exactly one workstream and cites the exact ticket revision, applicable specification versions, diff, commits, and producing run when one exists.
terms: "A change set belongs to exactly one workstream and cites the exact ticket revision, applicable specification versions, diff, commits, and producing run when one exists."

children.name: A verification result is immutable and evaluates one exact change set; reruns produce new verification identities and evidence artifacts.
terms: "A verification result is immutable and evaluates one exact change set; reruns produce new verification identities and evidence artifacts."

children.name: Passed means the named verification completed successfully, not that every required gate passed or that deployment is authorized.
terms: "Passed means the named verification completed successfully, not that every required gate passed or that deployment is authorized."

children.name: Deployment is authorized only when the target environment's current policy-required verifications and approvals pass for the exact unchanged change set.
terms: "Deployment is authorized only when the target environment's current policy-required verifications and approvals pass for the exact unchanged change set."

children.name: A deployment result always records an immutable artifact and external reference when execution occurred outside this system.
terms: "A deployment result always records an immutable artifact and external reference when execution occurred outside this system."

children.name: Rollback creates evidence and changes deployment state but never erases the failed or unhealthy deployment history.
terms: "Rollback creates evidence and changes deployment state but never erases the failed or unhealthy deployment history."

children.name: Completing delivery does not mark a ticket done; production observation and any required operational evidence belong to a separate responsibility.
terms: "Completing delivery does not mark a ticket done; production observation and any required operational evidence belong to a separate responsibility."

children.name: Delivery timeline access follows workstream access and never exposes protected code, build output, credentials, or environments by possession of an identifier.
terms: "Delivery timeline access follows workstream access and never exposes protected code, build output, credentials, or environments by possession of an identifier."
